description.narrative: “Communication Across Cultures” is seeking to develop a partnership the NGO Civil and Ecological Rights Association - SEHAK which is part of GoFor. SEHAK is located in Istanbul, Turkey. Both organizations focus on spreading awareness about human rights among youth. SEHAK runs youth-oriented social communication programmes to educate about things such as anti-semitism and human rights. Communication Across Cultures main purpose is to spread awareness about the importance of effective communication and dialoguing across cultures and country borders. Communication between people with different skin-colors, different religions, different upgrowings and worldviews. Both organizations aim to help the youth put aside their prejudices about other people, cultures, religions etc. The purpose of the trip will be to meet each other and get a better understanding of the organizations and discuss ideas for a potential Pilot project. By meeting each other face to face and understanding the environment SEHAK works in we expect to gain a better view on what would be relevant for the youth in this area, which workshops we could do, what a specific topic there could be for a future project, so we can create the best possible opportunities for the Turkish youth.
